raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT run_id, resolution, superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL), bound AS (SELECT bound_ms FROM provenance.v_sla_bound WHERE sla_metric = 'encoder_delay'), pool AS (SELECT p.run_id, p.window_name, p.p99_ms, d.resolution FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p USING (run_id) WHERE p.is_current = true AND p.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay'), pool_coverage AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resolution IS NOT NULL) AS resolution_tagged_pool_rows FROM pool), fabrics AS (SELECT f.handoff_gbps, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(p.window_name, '')) LIKE '%burst%') AS burst_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(p.window_name, '')) LIKE '%burst%' AND p.p99_ms <= b.bound_ms) AS burst_rows_within_bound, MIN(p.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(p.window_name, '')) LIKE '%burst%') AS min_burst_p99_ms, MAX(p.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(p.window_name, '')) LIKE '%burst%') AS max_burst_p99_ms FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.v_fabric_sensitivity f USING (run_id) JOIN pool p USING (run_id) CROSS JOIN bound b WHERE f.handoff_gbps IN (25, 100) GROUP BY f.handoff_gbps), collector AS (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT image_px ORDER BY image_px) AS measured_px, MAX(image_px) AS max_measured_px, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'aic' AND image_px = 448 AND n_images = 64) AS aic_batch64_448_ms, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'aic' AND image_px = 672 AND n_images = 64) AS aic_batch64_672_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = true), fabric_summary AS (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('handoff_gbps', handoff_gbps, 'burst_rows', burst_rows, 'within_bound', burst_rows_within_bound, 'min_p99_ms', min_burst_p99_ms, 'max_p99_ms', max_burst_p99_ms) ORDER BY handoff_gbps) AS summary FROM fabrics) SELECT b.bound_ms, c.measured_px, c.max_measured_px, c.aic_batch64_448_ms, c.aic_batch64_672_ms, pc.resolution_tagged_pool_rows, fs.summary AS fabric_burst_summary FROM bound b CROSS JOIN collector c CROSS JOIN pool_coverage pc CROSS JOIN fabric_summary fs
